tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The base behind everything: the operations view backdrop in ops, the page of a menu or a letter in ledger. Wet soil and galvanised steel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels that sit on ground: the operations panel, a robot card, a dialog.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit on a panel: key caps, meter tracks, a selected row.

tokens.name: hud-scrim
tokens.usage: The ground of every HUD panel drawn over the 3D world: 90% in ops, 94% in ledger, so text holds 4.5:1 whatever the world shows behind it, a white sky or a black night.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a panel. Decoration only: never the only sign of a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: a button outline, an input, the edge of a meter. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on ground, surface, surface-raised and hud-scrim.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on ground, surface, surface-raised and hud-scrim.

tokens.name: wheat
tokens.usage: Ripe wheat gold, the money and harvest colour. A fill: cash chips, the harvest meter, the primary highlight, the planter's seed hopper. Text on it is on-wheat.

tokens.name: on-wheat
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a wheat fill.

tokens.name: wheat-ink
tokens.usage: Gold used as text: money figures, a highlighted number, on ground, surface, surface-raised and hud-scrim.

tokens.name: machine
tokens.usage: Hi-vis machine orange. The fill of the one action the player should take now, and the body colour of every robot. Text on it is on-machine.

tokens.name: on-machine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a machine fill.

tokens.name: start-green
tokens.usage: The title bar of the flowchart start box, with on-machine text. One value in both themes, so the text always holds contrast.

tokens.name: machine-ink
tokens.usage: Orange used as text or as an icon: a robot's name, a link, on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: Alarm red. The fill of danger: the event banner body, a destructive button. Text on it is on-alarm.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an alarm fill.

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: Hazard tape yellow. Only for the striped edge of an event, warning stripes on the base, and the event waypoint. Never a text colour.

tokens.name: hazard-ink
tokens.usage: The black stripe of hazard tape, and text on a hazard fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Working as planned: a robot harvesting, a full meter. Always with its word and its round mark.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: low battery, a job running late. Always with its word and its triangle mark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Needs the player now: a stuck robot, an animal loose. Always with its word and its square mark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral activity: charging, driving to the field. Always with its word and its diamond mark.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Nothing assigned. Always with its word and its ring mark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring on every control, 2px solid. Holds 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: The black line drawn round every object in the 3D world, and the drawn detail on it.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The near-black the dark step of light mixes towards, so anything out of the sun keeps a trace of its own colour. Cool, against the warm sunlight, so a shaded face differs in colour and not only in brightness.

tokens.name: regolith
tokens.usage: The ground outside: the Moon's grey regolith.

tokens.name: regolith-dark
tokens.usage: Crater floors and freshly dug regolith.

tokens.name: rock
tokens.usage: Boulders and crater rims.

tokens.name: hull
tokens.usage: Module walls: white insulated panels.

tokens.name: hull-trim
tokens.usage: Frames, corridor rings, door edges, the low walls of the greenhouse beds.

tokens.name: grow-light
tokens.usage: The magenta glow of the greenhouse grow lights.

tokens.name: space
tokens.usage: The sky on the Moon: black, day or night.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Stars.

tokens.name: earth-ocean
tokens.usage: Earth in the sky: its oceans.

tokens.name: earth-cloud
tokens.usage: Earth in the sky: its clouds and ice.

tokens.name: earth-land
tokens.usage: Earth in the sky: its green land.

tokens.name: earth-desert
tokens.usage: Earth in the sky: its deserts, in a belt either side of the equator.

tokens.name: mars-dust
tokens.usage: Mars: the rust-red dust over the whole ball, from the ground and from space.

tokens.name: solar-panel
tokens.usage: Solar panels outside the base.

tokens.name: crop-stubble
tokens.usage: A plant just harvested. Plants fade stubble, then crop-green, then crop-ripe as they grow.

tokens.name: crop-green
tokens.usage: A growing plant.

tokens.name: crop-ripe
tokens.usage: A plant ready for harvest.

tokens.name: soil
tokens.usage: Treated regolith in the greenhouse beds: darker and richer than the ground outside.

tokens.name: roof-steel
tokens.usage: Module roofs and the dark edges of panels.

tokens.name: deck
tokens.usage: Floors inside the modules: grey decking.

tokens.name: skin
tokens.usage: A person's face and bare hands. One tone for everybody: the look draws people in flat colour and nobody in this game has a face.

tokens.name: overall
tokens.usage: The crew's work clothes indoors. Work blue, so a person reads against the white hull and is never mistaken for a robot, which is machine orange.

tokens.name: overall-trim
tokens.usage: The collar, cuffs and pockets of the crew's work suit: a darker work blue, so the suit's shape reads at room distance.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hair and eyebrows. One dark brown for everybody while the crew are a placeholder (#36).

tokens.name: eye-white
tokens.usage: The whites of a person's eyes. Warm, not pure white, so a face does not stare.

tokens.name: iris
tokens.usage: The dark middle of a person's eyes.

tokens.name: lips
tokens.usage: A person's lips: a little darker and redder than skin, enough to find the mouth in flat colour.

tokens.name: suit-pad
tokens.usage: The grey knee and elbow pads of the space suit, after NASA's AxEMU (#36).

tokens.name: suit-stripe
tokens.usage: The space suit's red, only ever as a stripe: over the hood and along the pack's top edge. Never a fill.

tokens.name: visor
tokens.usage: The space suit's visor: dark chrome with a faint green, never gold.

tokens.name: suit-sole
tokens.usage: The pale-blue lugged soles of the space suit's boots.

tokens.name: rubber
tokens.usage: Tyres, cabs, cables, monitor stands.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Bare metal parts of a machine: cutter bars, arms.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Cab glass, dark screens.

tokens.name: clear-glass
tokens.usage: Panes you see through: the link tubes and the greenhouse glazing. Mostly clear, with a cold tint so the pane still reads as there.

tokens.name: screen-teal
tokens.usage: The glow of a workstation screen showing data.

tokens.name: beacon-ok
tokens.usage: Robot beacon light: working.

tokens.name: beacon-stuck
tokens.usage: Robot beacon light: needs the player. Blinks, so colour is never the only sign.

tokens.name: beacon-charging
tokens.usage: Robot beacon light: charging or driving to the charger.

tokens.name: camp-beacon
tokens.usage: The first expedition's camp on Mars: the lamp on its radio mast and the beam standing up from it, seen over the curve of the ground.

tokens.name: sun-day
tokens.usage: Sunlight on the Moon: white and harsh, with no air to soften it.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: Indoor lamps in the habitat, the workshop and the airlock.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Screen titles: the main menu, a season card, the yearly profit reveal. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: The name at the top of a panel or card.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels: panel section names, meter names, key caps. Always uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The harvester is stuck in the mud on row 12.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The part of a sentence that says what to do.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Charging at the barn, back in 2 min
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a heading or a figure.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Anything a machine reports: telemetry, tables, readings. Tabular figures, so digits line up in columns.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The two figures always on screen: the clock and the cash. Condensed, tabular figures, so they do not jump as they tick.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a mark and its word inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value; pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the gap between HUD panels and the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of the operations panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panels in the operations view.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, key caps, meters. Pressed steel, barely eased.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the ledger's paper sheets only.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: The one shadow: a hard 2px drop under panels and buttons, like a stamped plate. No soft shadows anywhere.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers and panel outlines.

tokens.name: border-plate
tokens.usage: Buttons, focus rings, the top edge of a panel header.
